gaps.sentence: Our street was cut ___ for three hours after the storm.
gaps.explanation: cut off = disconnected (power, phone); isolate (a village cut off by snow).

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: The factory laid ___ two hundred workers.
gaps.explanation: lay off = dismiss workers because there is not enough work.

gaps.sentence: They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: Can we narrow the list ___ to three names?
gaps.explanation: narrow down = reduce the number of possibilities.

gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.
They put ___ the meeting until everyone could attend.
